International Patients

International Patient Care in Bangalore

Plan your hair, skin, aesthetic, body-contouring or fertility consultation journey with clear clinical guidance before you travel to Bangalore. The process begins with your concern and the information your doctor needs—not with a preset package.

Not Medical Tourism Packages. A Care Plan.

International care works best when the clinical pathway is understood before travel. NeoSculpt6 helps patients begin with a structured conversation, share the information relevant to their concern and understand what may need an in-person assessment. Recommendations are made around diagnosis, suitability, preparation and realistic treatment goals.

Three Steps. No Uncertainty.

  • 01

    Share the Context

    Tell us what you would like help with, your country of residence, preferred travel window and any previous treatment history. This helps the team route your enquiry appropriately.

  • 02

    Share Relevant Records

    Depending on the concern, we may request reports, prescriptions, investigations, photographs or short videos. Hair enquiries may need scalp and donor-area photographs; other treatments have different information requirements.

  • 03

    Speak With the Right Team

    A preliminary review or virtual consultation helps you understand the relevant clinical pathway, preparation, likely clinic visits and the next decision to make before travelling.

One Place. Six Clinical Pathways.

Hair Restoration

For hair thinning, pattern hair loss and transplant enquiries, the pathway may include virtual review, donor assessment, scalp examination, graft planning where appropriate, treatment guidance and follow-up planning.

  • Neo Follicle Hair Transplant
  • FUE Hair Transplant
  • DHI Hair Transplant
  • PRP Hair Treatment

Laser and Skin Aesthetic Care

For acne scars, pigmentation, texture concerns, vitiligo, laser procedures and skin refinement, recommendations depend on diagnosis, skin type, treatment history and recovery requirements.

  • CO2 Fractional Laser Treatment
  • Q-Switch Laser Treatment
  • Acne Scar Laser Treatment
  • Full Body Laser Hair Removal

Anti-Aging and Injectables

For anti-ageing and injectable-treatment enquiries, the consultation focuses on skin and facial assessment, treatment goals, appropriate options, safety considerations and realistic outcomes.

  • Botox Treatment
  • Dermal Filler Treatment
  • Profhilo
  • HIFU Treatment

Cosmetic Surgery

For surgical aesthetic enquiries, the in-person consultation focuses on anatomy, medical suitability, procedure options, recovery planning and what can realistically be achieved.

  • Rhinoplasty
  • Facelift Surgery
  • Blepharoplasty (Eyelid Surgery)
  • Tummy Tuck Surgery (Abdominoplasty)

Slimming and Body Contouring

For localised body-shape, fat-reduction, skin-tightening or body-contouring concerns, the team assesses the treatment area, skin quality, anatomy, lifestyle factors and whether a surgical or non-surgical approach may be appropriate.

  • Body Contouring
  • Cryolipolysis Treatment
  • Lipolaser Treatment
  • Medical Weight Loss Treatment

Fertility Care

For fertility-related concerns, the team can explain the consultation pathway and the records or investigations that may be relevant before a treatment plan is considered.

Your Journey

The Plan Continues After You Arrive.

Share your concern and preferred timeline.

Provide the information requested for a preliminary review.

Discuss the likely pathway, suitability questions and preparation.

Plan appointments around the recommended consultation, treatment and early recovery period.

The specialist confirms the clinical factors that cannot be assessed fully online.

If treatment is appropriate, you receive a personalised plan, aftercare instructions and recovery guidance.

Where appropriate, the team explains the recommended remote review process after you return home.

What to Arrange Before You Travel.

Keep relevant reports, prescriptions and treatment history organised. Tell the team about medical conditions, allergies, medications and previous procedures so that the consultation can be planned safely.

The right length of stay depends on your treatment, number of required visits, procedure plan and early recovery review. Avoid tightly scheduled travel around consultations or procedures. Visa, travel and accommodation arrangements remain the responsibility of the patient and the relevant authorities.

Clinical Advice Before Aesthetic Decisions.

On arrival, the appropriate specialist completes the in-person assessment, reviews the treatment goals and confirms whether the proposed plan remains suitable. You should understand the expected outcome, limitations, aftercare, alternatives and follow-up before deciding how to proceed.
